title: 2.8.2.2 dev Automation regression (Actions removed)
body:
With latest dev, actions recorded in automation rules are removed and it's impossible to add or customize action's settings
If I revert this commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/dfdea8273127b7a885e60ce79c4d7badf72b142c it works...
